title: Review coordinator output
description: Structured output contract for the review-pack coordinator (spec D4): one batched review event plus deduped findings. Findings only on lines present in the posted diff.

event.description: Review event for the single POST /pulls/{n}/reviews call. Mapping: any critical -> REQUEST_CHANGES; warnings only -> COMMENT; else APPROVE.

summary.description: Human-readable review summary body (posted as the review comment).

findings.description: Batched inline findings. Empty array when there is nothing to flag (for example a lockfile-only diff).

path.description: Repo-relative file path the finding belongs to.

position.description: Diff position (GitHub pulls review comment `position`), not a file line number.

severity.description: critical = outage/exploitable; warning = measurable regression; suggestion = optional improvement.

rule_id.description: Stable rule identifier that produced the finding (used by fingerprinting and dedupe).

body.description: Inline comment body for the finding.

fingerprint.description: sha256 of path + rule_id + normalized snippet (scripts/review-fingerprint.sh). Line numbers are excluded so the fingerprint survives force-push/rebase.
